newsitem.title: UK: Hyder sells 40 percent CableTel stake.
newsitem.headline: Hyder sells 40 percent CableTel stake.

text.p: Hyder Plc said it had sold the 40 percent stake in CableTel South Wales held by its subidiary, South Wales Electricity Plc, to International CableTel Incorporated.
CableTel is buying the stake with $78 million of CableTel non-voting convertible preferred stock.
The UK joint water and electricity utility said that although it believed the cable industry had a successful future, the unit did not fit in with Hyder's core skills.

CableTel is a U.S. quoted holding company. The preferred stock will be convertible into CableTel common stock. Dividends will not be payable for five years, but thereafter will be payable at the rate of five percent per year in cash, common or additional preferred stock, Hyder said in a statement.
